bns:Component.name: Produce_P2P_ExecutionLog_Event
bns:Component.bns:description: Event Streams Produce operation for the Endeavour Mining P2P framework's Sub_Execution_Logger. Publishes to topic "edv.transaction.log" (renamed 2026-09-28: consolidated onto the account's pre-existing edv.* topic naming convention - this Produce and the matching Consume operation had briefly drifted to inconsistent topic names, esb.transaction.log vs esb.p2p.transaction.log, during same-day troubleshooting by two people; edv.transaction.log is the settled name on both sides). producerAccessMode=Shared because every interface's Sub_Execution_Logger subprocess call may produce concurrently. The "CorrelationId" messageProperties slot is defined blank here and bound dynamically at the process step (dynamicProperties) - best-effort tagging only. Boomi Event Streams' partition/ordering guarantee for this field is NOT confirmed in available documentation; treat "Message Key = CorrelationId" ordering as aspirational, not verified, until platform behavior is tested directly. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57
